answer: An agent cannot attest until three established peers vouch for it, and each voucher escrows 2,000 POA. Slashing cascades three hops: if a jury proves the newcomer a sybil, the voucher's bond burns plus 25 percent of every sponsor above it. Probationers get one attestation per epoch, so burst minting fails. An ocean of fresh keys still has to climb the same three-vouch canyon, and forging 1,000 identities freezes 9 million POA on a public vine of signed vouches that a jury can unspool in minutes. Think of bail: cheap to cosign once, ruinous at scale, with your own cash in the cell.
